Looking at the lower half of the disk (below diameter AB), the angles along the straight line must sum to 180°.

**Finding the shaded angle:**
- Given angles: 30°, 65°, 40°
- Shaded angle = 180° − (30° + 65° + 40°) = 180° − 135° = 45°

**Computing the probability:**
The probability equals the ratio of the sector's angle to the full circle:
P = 45° / 360° = 1/8

\boxed{1/8}
